verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a hosted REST API for running AI-powered browser tasks (smooth-docs-20, smooth-docs-13), with task list and cancel endpoints (smooth-docs-37, smooth-docs-38). Results are retrieved by polling, which the docs state is the chosen mechanism over webhooks (smooth-docs-36). The browser runs on Smooth's side, not the user's machine (smooth-comm-11), and the story's 'polling or webhook' is satisfied by polling. Missing for 10: no webhook delivery option, no published OpenAPI spec (smooth-probe-2), and no independent hands-on corroboration of the submit/poll HTTP flow.
